name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: Replaces the system pointer on desktop with a spring-animated arrow that lags behind the mouse, rotates toward the direction of travel and dips slightly when it moves fast.
use: A playful portfolio or landing page wants a branded pointer that reacts to movement.
avoid: Accessibility-sensitive or precision tools; hiding the native cursor can hurt usability.
a11y: It hides the native cursor on desktop and never checks reduced-motion, and offers no extra focus or selection cue. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark demo panel holding a small outlined pill, a bold heading, a line of grey text, and a white arrow cursor with a thin dark outline. The arrow is the only thing that moves against the flat black card.
behaves: The arrow chases the real pointer with a spring so it trails and overshoots slightly, turns toward the direction of travel, and shrinks for a moment whenever the pointer speeds up.
customise: Pass any node as cursor to swap the arrow and tune the follow with springConfig; the desktop-only activation rule is fixed in the source.
weight: light: One fixed element moved by pointer events; idle whenever the pointer is still.
demo: A dark card reading Smooth Cursor above the heading Move your mouse around and a short paragraph.
polishWhy: Smooth spring motion and a crisp default arrow; the demo card explains itself neatly.
